headline: Headline assessment
topFindingsNote: The {shown} highest-ranked of {total} findings are listed here. Every finding, with its quoted evidence, is in Annex A.
verifyFirstIntro: These items are not verified, yet they would be Critical or High if confirmed. Collect their evidence before relying on the rest of the roadmap.
matrixIntro: Finding IDs by severity (rows) and estimated effort (columns). Effort is an order-of-magnitude estimate of the client team's work, in person-days.
quickWinsIntro: High or Critical findings that need small or medium effort.
noQuickWins: No finding is both High or Critical and small or medium in effort.
waveTotal: Estimated effort of this wave: {total} person-days.
waveTotalOpen: Estimated effort of this wave: at least {min} person-days (an action is open-ended).
roadmapViolationsIntro: The roadmap checks still failed after two retries. These problems are left visible on purpose.
noDecisions: No decision from the client is pending.
notVerifiedIntro: These claims have no evidence that a script could check. They are not findings: each one has an action to collect its evidence.
noNotVerified: Every finding is backed by evidence; nothing was left unverified.
scaleOverride: This report uses the client's own scale instead of the default severity table or effort ranges: {note}
limitsLine: A script checked that each cited excerpt exists where the report says it does. It did not check that the excerpt supports the claim; that judgement is for the reader, and Critical and High findings show their quotes for that reason.
notReviewed: This report was not human-reviewed. It was generated without a reviewer's approval.
name: Name
headlineText: This assessment of {client} reports {findings} finding(s): {critical} Critical, {high} High, {medium} Medium, {low} Low and {info} Info. {unverified} claim(s) could not be verified and are listed separately. {quickwins} finding(s) are quick wins.
noFindings: No finding is backed by verified evidence.
redactedText: redacted secret of kind {kind}; only the location is shown
absenceText: not found in {scope} (pattern {pattern}); this shows no match in those files, not that the control exists nowhere
mappingUnchecked: Control IDs without a supplied catalog are unchecked: the mapping was not compared with the framework text.
modelUnknown: unknown (the model identifier was not given)

reportedByNames.agent: the agent itself, which may be wrong

verifierTitle: What the verifier does and does not prove
verifierProves: It proves that each cited excerpt exists at the cited lines of the inventoried files, that an absence search found no match in a non-empty scope, and that saved output has not changed since capture.
verifierDoesNot: It does not prove that an excerpt supports the claim, that an absence search covers every place a control could live, or that a statement, document or web page is true.
secretScan: A heuristic scan looks for secrets in the data and in this report. It cannot prove there are none: a person must still look before the report leaves the team.
conventionsIntro: Confidence, severity and effort follow fixed rules computed by code, not by the model. The thresholds are conventions of this skill, not findings of research.
confidenceRules: Confidence: Verified means at least one machine-checked citation passes; Corroborated means two independent sources and none machine-checked; Reported means one source; Not verified means no evidence or every citation failed. Only Verified findings can be Critical or High; Corroborated and Reported are capped at Medium.
defaultScale: Default severity and effort scales were used.
changeDescription: First issue of the assessment report with {findings} finding(s) and {unverified} not verified.
